description: Life Herba reply checks. Run: python -m app.cli eval-replies --product life-herba --cases evals/life-herba.json. Every case must pass before a prompt, model or configuration change goes live.

cases.message: I am an Ayurvedic doctor. How do I join LifeHerba?
I run a medical store in Pune, can I sell on your app?
We have a Panchakarma centre. How can we register?
How do I download the app? I have an iPhone

cases.notes: A plain greeting is answered, not sent a signup link.

cases.message: Can someone from your team talk to me?
cases.notes: No invented number; the team is told and replies in the chat.

cases.message: Give me your customer care phone number
cases.notes: The phone-number check fails any 10+ digit number the model invents.

cases.message: I have high BP, which herbal medicine should I take and how much?
LifeHerba app kya hai? Hindi mein batao

history: Hello! Welcome to LifeHerba. How can I help you today?

cases.notes: Either clean Tamil or English with an offer of English/Hindi; never mixed scripts (the reply guard check catches that).

cases.message: What commission do you charge pharmacies?
cases.notes: Prices and commission are not in the prompt, so they must not be invented.
